rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something makes an action or process easier.

example.english: Having mobile payment really does facilitate things.
example.traditional: 有手機付款真係方便好多。
example.jyutping: jau5 sau2 gei1 fu6 fun2 zan1 hai6 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when someone or something helps bring about a specific result, such as an agreement or cooperation.

example.english: The mediator helped facilitate the signing of the agreement.
example.traditional: 調解員從中促成雙方簽約。
example.jyutping: tiu4 gaai2 jyun4 cung4 zung1 cuk1 sing4 soeng1 fong1 cim1 joek3
